title: ResumeThreadParams
description:
Params of the `engine/resume_thread` RPC.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ResumeThreadParams; let p: ResumeThreadParams = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"threadId":"thread:native/abc"}"#).unwrap(); assert_eq!(p.thread_id.0.as_ref(), "thread:native/abc"); ```

threadId.description: Thread to restore into engine memory.
